bootstrap.scope: conditional on three trained members; seed spread descriptive, not retraining posterior

claims.SERVICE_probe: separate optional registered native-contract development study only; no change to original24 confirmation

confirmation.below_minimum: inconclusive, no RF superiority or alignment-benefit claims; allcohortcounts retained

data.censoring: actual sensitivity/noisefloor operator applied to traced power; no-solved-path remains missing, never invented weak label

context_regimes.sparse: same two planned poses0,10 across all states,8 scheduled tokens/view

data.context_schedule_scope: planned probe report availability, no network delivery/timing guarantee
data.frontend_calibration: offline full TRAIN paired context reports only, same shared device0gauge calibration for both online schedules; no trueoffset/private gain used
data.held_band: supplementary6GHz same even physical context links; no6GHz fitting/calibration/gate
data.known_tx_dbm: per-layout fixed cycle -20,-10,0,10; same across3conditions, included in public free-space operator
data.private_condition: obstacle material only: metal/wood/brick; labels/material/seed/sourceIDs never model features
data.splits: whole geometry; disjoint from prior120 CADs and other splits
data.stale_context: for targets condition1/2 use same-layout condition0 contexts; condition0 unchanged; current public geometry/knownTX

metrics.delta_cohort: both reports heard at identical query pose/AP/band/direction/device; both pairs need>=1common query for usable layout
metrics.delta_rmse: pool squared prediction-minus-target differences over two pairs withinlayout, then root; never assign censored pointtargets
metrics.detector_brier: P(heard)=GaussianCDF((mean-detection_threshold_dbm)/std), using explicit threshold target metadata for bothheard andcensored; poolallknown events across3states; missing/unresolved excluded. Detection threshold never a model input.
metrics.pair_detection: report bothheard/oneheard/bothcensored/missing counts, no invented joint-event probability
metrics.scalar_rmse_and_p95: pool heard errors across three conditions withinlayout
metrics.seed_aggregation: compute each member metric first, arithmeticmean withinlayout; predictions never ensembled
metrics.unavailable: retain every geometry/case andcounts/reason; unavailable delta ifeitherpair lacksbothheard, no scene/support substitution

neural.alignment: joint uncertainty-weighted same-state viewA/viewB posterior-mean agreement; exact regression disables alignment only

alignment_gradient_balance.reference: measurement RMS gradient wrt posterior means

neural.branch_selection: joint versus regression only; mean of three member VAL scores, canonical joint breaks exact ties
neural.checkpoint: minimum sparse VAL mean usable-layout condition-deltaRMSE; first epoch breaks ties
neural.condition_sampling: each update independently samples one of3conditions uniformly for each of24distinct TRAINlayouts, seeded NumPy stream matched acrosscells
neural.marginal_latent_prior: none; no new prior selection grid
neural.model: physics beta8 approximate Gaussian posterior mean/covariance, geometry/set-attention prior, bounded localgeometry correction, three censored-likelihood update iterations
neural.pure_geometry: RF/status values erased and original observed-mask replaced with planned schedule; pure public geometry/knownTX metadata
neural.regime_schedule: update parity alternates full/sparse: foureach per epoch
neural.rf_erased: erase RF amplitude/value columns0/1 only; retain heard/censored status columns2/3 and reported availability mask. Strong RF-value-erased control, not pureCAD.
neural.uncertainty_scope: approximate Gaussian static RF field forecast, not packet or production risk
